prompt_policy: Exact frozen v6 input binding; this amendment does not change generation text or media.

T01_C01.target: 追踪初始书本、两只罐子和杯子。
T01_C01.target_en: Track the initial book, two cans and mug by appearance and spatial continuity from the first frame. Do not substitute new objects for original actors.

full_chain.name: 第2罐接触杯子且杯子末态位移超过3厘米
full_chain.definition: can2/mug contact AND mug final displacement >0.03 m
full_chain.definition_zh: 原T01 full_chain判据。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。

can_2_mug_contact.name: 第2罐接触原杯子
can_2_mug_contact.definition: The same initial t01v2_chain_can_2 visibly makes physical contact with the same initial t01v2_chain_mug within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
can_2_mug_contact.definition_zh: 第2罐接触原杯子。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

mug_final_displacement_gt_3cm.name: 杯子末态三维位移 > 3 cm
mug_final_displacement_gt_3cm.definition: Euclidean distance between the original mug center at observation end and at observation start is strictly greater than 0.03 m. This is final displacement, not path length or maximum displacement.
mug_final_displacement_gt_3cm.definition_zh: 杯子末态三维位移 > 3 cm。按登记量、单位和比较符测量；缺标定或不能测量时填不可判，不凭像素距离推算物理量。

T01_C01.order_scope: expected causal ordering only; annotate actual order, do not force labels or times to fit it
T01_C01.annotation_policy_zh: 判断质量与事件是否发生；无法判断选不可判。

book_motion.name: 书本沿原斜面/桌面平移

stack_book_can_1_contact.name: 至少一本原堆叠书接触第1罐
stack_book_can_1_contact.definition: At least one of the original bottom/middle/top stack books physically contacts can 1. Name the actual contacting book(s).
stack_book_can_1_contact.definition_zh: 至少一本原堆叠书接触第1罐。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。

definition.name: 支撑条位移达到原配置释放间隙
definition.definition: Maximum absolute world-y displacement of the original support bar reaches the release-clearance value declared in this exact source configuration.

definition.name: 书堆达到原stack_motion判据
definition.definition: At least one original stack book has maximum forward x displacement >0.12 m OR maximum downward center displacement >0.025 m. Do not equate any visible wobble with this numeric criterion.
definition.definition_zh: 书堆达到原stack_motion判据。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。

stack_motion.reason: 实际配置为V4；所恢复数值审计器为V3，缺同版本规则绑定

definition.name: 原杯子相对初态最大三维旋转 ≥ 18°
definition.definition: Maximum quaternion/geodesic orientation change of the original mug relative to its initial pose reaches 18 degrees; camera-projected yaw is not automatically the same quantity.
definition.definition_zh: 原杯子相对初态最大三维旋转 ≥ 18°。按登记量、单位和比较符测量；缺标定或不能测量时填不可判，不凭像素距离推算物理量。

mug_rotation_ge_18deg.reason: 实际配置为V4；所恢复数值审计器为V3，缺同版本规则绑定

definition.name: 原末端传递判据：接触且杯子旋转 ≥18°

support_bar_moves.definition_zh: 原支撑条被抽出。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。

stack_book_can_1_contact.name: 至少一本原堆叠书接触第1罐
stack_book_can_1_contact.definition: At least one of the original bottom/middle/top stack books physically contacts can 1. Name the actual contacting book(s).
stack_book_can_1_contact.definition_zh: 至少一本原堆叠书接触第1罐。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。

can_1_can_2_contact.name: 第1罐接触第2罐
can_1_can_2_contact.definition: The same initial t04v3_chain_can_1 visibly makes physical contact with the same initial t04v3_chain_can_2 within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
can_1_can_2_contact.definition_zh: 第1罐接触第2罐。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

can_2_mug_contact.name: 第2罐接触原杯子
can_2_mug_contact.definition: The same initial t04v3_chain_can_2 visibly makes physical contact with the same initial t04v3_chain_mug within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
can_2_mug_contact.definition_zh: 第2罐接触原杯子。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

definition.name: 支撑条位移达到原配置释放间隙

motion_ge_1cm.name: 原手机最大三维位移 ≥ 1 cm

folder_descends_after_support_loss.definition_zh: 失去支撑后原文件夹向下运动。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。

contacted_eraser.name: 原长笔接触末端橡皮

T15_C01.target: 初始画面中，绿色书本右侧、桌面上的灰色闭合笔记本电脑。

book_contacts_laptop.name: 书本接触初始笔记本

laptop_leaves_table.definition: The laptop completely loses its original tabletop support within the observation window; overhang or rotation with remaining edge contact is not sufficient.
laptop_leaves_table.name: 笔记本完全脱离原桌面支撑
laptop_leaves_table.definition_zh: 初始灰色笔记本完全失去原桌面支撑。部分越缘、倾斜或仍与桌边接触不等于完全脱离。

laptop_descends.definition: After complete separation from the original tabletop, the same laptop visibly moves downward across at least two supplied times. Floor contact is not required.
laptop_descends.name: 脱离后下落
laptop_descends.definition_zh: 同一初始笔记本在完全脱离原桌面后，至少两个实际时间点显示向下运动。不要求落地；不能用后来新出现的笔记本替代。

laptop_contacts_phone.definition: The same laptop visibly contacts the phone initially on the floor below the table; proximity or overlap alone is insufficient.
laptop_contacts_phone.name: 笔记本接触初始地面手机
laptop_contacts_phone.definition_zh: 同一初始笔记本与初始位于桌子右下方地面的手机发生可确认接触。相邻或重叠不足以确认。

phone_moves_after_contact.definition: After visible laptop-phone contact the phone visibly moves from its initial floor position. Camera motion alone is insufficient.
phone_moves_after_contact.name: 接触后手机移动
phone_moves_after_contact.definition_zh: 在可确认的笔记本—手机接触后，原地面手机相对初始位置发生可见移动。仅镜头运动不算。

actors.anchor: 原首帧对象；按空间连续性追踪，不能由新物体替代
原首帧对象；按空间连续性追踪，不能由新物体替代

folder_downstream_contact.name: 文件夹接触下游盒子
folder_downstream_contact.definition: The original folder and downstream box contact at least once in the observation window. This is the native contact event in the source event sequence, distinct from downstream displacement.

downstream_response_original.name: 下游盒子产生响应
downstream_response_original.definition: Original tips_and_triggers_downstream predicate: downstream box final-to-first 3D displacement strictly exceeds 0.015 m. Maximum excursion and contact alone are not this predicate.

folder_motion_original.name: 文件夹达到原运动判据
folder_motion_original.definition: Original folder final-to-first 3D displacement strictly exceeds 0.08 m; original outcome gives downstream response priority over this secondary condition.
folder_motion_original.definition_zh: 文件夹达到原运动判据

T16_C01.order_scope: expected causal ordering only; annotate actual order, do not force labels or times to fit it

support_withdrawal.name: 原支撑书撤出
support_withdrawal.definition: The same initial t16_support_book visibly translates relative to stable original scene geometry over at least two supplied times. Camera motion, a changed appearance, rotation alone, or a substitute actor is insufficient.
support_withdrawal.definition_zh: 原支撑书撤出。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。

folder_loses_original_support.name: 原文件夹完全失去原支撑书支撑
folder_loses_original_support.definition: The same initial t16_folder completely loses support/contact from the original t16_support_book. Partial overhang or tilting while still supported is insufficient; floor impact is a separate event.
folder_loses_original_support.definition_zh: 原文件夹完全失去原支撑书支撑。必须完全失去原支撑；仍接触边缘、局部越缘或倾斜不算。下落和落地另记，出画不自动判发生。

folder_rotation_after_support_loss.name: 失去支撑后原文件夹发生转动
folder_rotation_after_support_loss.definition: The same original folder visibly changes orientation after complete original support loss. A camera rotation or substituted object is insufficient.
folder_rotation_after_support_loss.definition_zh: 失去支撑后原文件夹发生转动。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。

folder_table_impact.name: 原文件夹接触原桌面
folder_table_impact.definition: The same initial t16_folder visibly makes physical contact with the same initial @original_tabletop within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
folder_table_impact.definition_zh: 原文件夹接触原桌面。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

box_moves_after_folder_contact.name: 原盒子在文件夹接触后平移
box_moves_after_folder_contact.definition: The same initial t16_downstream_box visibly translates relative to stable original scene geometry over at least two supplied times. Camera motion, a changed appearance, rotation alone, or a substitute actor is insufficient. The movement must follow confirmed folder/box contact.
box_moves_after_folder_contact.definition_zh: 原盒子在文件夹接触后平移。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。需在确认folder/box contact后。

book_motion.name: 原书本运动
book_motion.definition: The same initial t20_book visibly translates relative to stable original scene geometry over at least two supplied times. Camera motion, a changed appearance, rotation alone, or a substitute actor is insufficient.
book_motion.definition_zh: 原书本运动。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。

contact_book_can.name: 原书本接触原罐体
contact_book_can.definition: The same initial t20_book visibly makes physical contact with the same initial t20_can within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
contact_book_can.definition_zh: 原书本接触原罐体。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

can_motion_after_contact.name: 原罐体在书本接触后平移

complete_observed_propagation.name: 可见完整接力链（接触与后续运动）
complete_observed_propagation.definition: All three named contact links and each named receiver translation are observed. This is an observation-vector conjunction, not an inferred force or an Isaac propagation-depth label.
complete_observed_propagation.definition_zh: 可见完整接力链（接触与后续运动）。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。

complete_propagation_original.definition_zh: 三段接触依次完成且杯子响应

T20_C05.order_scope: expected causal ordering only; annotate actual order, do not force labels or times to fit it
T20_C05.annotation_policy_zh: 判断质量与事件是否发生；无法判断选不可判。

book_motion.name: 原书本运动
book_motion.definition: The same initial t20_book visibly translates relative to stable original scene geometry over at least two supplied times. Camera motion, a changed appearance, rotation alone, or a substitute actor is insufficient.
book_motion.definition_zh: 原书本运动。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。

contact_book_can.name: 原书本接触原罐体
contact_book_can.definition: The same initial t20_book visibly makes physical contact with the same initial t20_can within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
contact_book_can.definition_zh: 原书本接触原罐体。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

can_motion_after_contact.name: 原罐体在书本接触后平移
can_motion_after_contact.definition: The same initial t20_can visibly translates relative to stable original scene geometry over at least two supplied times. Camera motion, a changed appearance, rotation alone, or a substitute actor is insufficient. The movement must follow confirmed book/can contact.
can_motion_after_contact.definition_zh: 原罐体在书本接触后平移。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。需在确认book/can contact后。

contact_can_box.name: 原罐体接触原盒子
contact_can_box.definition: The same initial t20_can visibly makes physical contact with the same initial t20_box within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
contact_can_box.definition_zh: 原罐体接触原盒子。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

box_motion_after_contact.name: 原盒子在罐体接触后平移
box_motion_after_contact.definition: The same initial t20_box visibly translates relative to stable original scene geometry over at least two supplied times. Camera motion, a changed appearance, rotation alone, or a substitute actor is insufficient. The movement must follow confirmed can/box contact.
box_motion_after_contact.definition_zh: 原盒子在罐体接触后平移。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。需在确认can/box contact后。

contact_box_cup.name: 原盒子接触原杯子
contact_box_cup.definition: The same initial t20_box visibly makes physical contact with the same initial t20_cup within the declared observation window. Proximity or pixel overlap alone is insufficient.
contact_box_cup.definition_zh: 原盒子接触原杯子。追踪原对象；仅靠近、遮挡或像素重叠不能确认接触。没有看清接触时填不可判。

cup_response.name: 原杯子在盒子接触后平移
cup_response.definition: The same initial t20_cup visibly translates relative to stable original scene geometry over at least two supplied times. Camera motion, a changed appearance, rotation alone, or a substitute actor is insufficient. The movement must follow confirmed box/cup contact.
cup_response.definition_zh: 原杯子在盒子接触后平移。需两个不同时间点的平移证据，排除镜头运动、仅旋转和新物体替代。需在确认box/cup contact后。

complete_observed_propagation.name: 可见完整接力链（接触与后续运动）
complete_observed_propagation.definition: All three named contact links and each named receiver translation are observed. This is an observation-vector conjunction, not an inferred force or an Isaac propagation-depth label.
complete_observed_propagation.definition_zh: 可见完整接力链（接触与后续运动）。逐项记录实际画面，不按提示词猜结局，也不为满足预期顺序修改标签。接触须有可确认的几何/运动证据，像素重叠或靠近不够。发生填首次可确认时间；未发生须看完整观察窗，至少两个证据时间；遮挡、出画、身份不清填不可判/未观察到。末态事件只判断观察窗末帧，不能用曾经发生代替。数值阈值需定量测量与标定依据，不能把像素当米。生成窗口标签不自动等于原参考全长标签；时域、参考、边界和配对准入另查。
